div.div: دَلَسٌ The dark; or darkness; (S, M, A, K;) as also ↓ دُلْسَةٌ : (A, Msb, K:) and the confusedness of the darkness, or of the beginning of night; expl. by اِخْتِلَاطُ الظَّلَامِ. (A, K.) You say, أَتَانَا دَلَسَ الظَّلَامِ He came to us in the confusedness of the darkness, or of the beginning of night. (TA.) And خَرَجَ فِى ٱلدَّلَسِ وَٱلْغَلَسِ [He went forth in the confusedness of the darkness, or of the beginning of night, and in the darkness of the last part of the night]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
